selection_rule: Import independent backend fixes; hold rebuilt systems and changes needing integration for individual review.
integration_method: Selective cherry-picks and explicit file selections. The upstream snapshot is not merged or marked fully integrated; use this ledger for subsequent syncs.
notes: The CHD reader has no Hollycast changes. Its content matches the final upstream snapshot because the original commit predates an earlier upstream pregap fix; this avoids retaining both pregap implementations.
The two partial imports exclude boxart changes and the global logging default.
Existing Hollycast fast-forward audio, command-line guards, render queue and OSD behavior are retained.
The save-state format remains V61. Imported buffer validation and serial rescheduling do not adopt the held V62 format changes.
Hollycast copyright headers are retained or added. Fixture generation preserves the CUE attribution comments.
Formatting-only changes in sector conversion are omitted. Imported CHD tests use scoped disc ownership to release resources on fatal assertion failures.

validation.source_review: Standards and scope source reviews completed; imported CHD test ownership cleanup corrected. No runtime verification.

review_queue.library-ui: Adapt controller navigation and image-button changes to the rebuilt library.
review_queue.boxart: Review retry and rate-limit behavior against Hollycast fetching stages and database ownership.
review_queue.video-rendering: Review Vulkan and swap-interval changes against OSD and custom textures; review Stretch to Fill in the custom settings UI.
review_queue.android-lifecycle: Review activity, frame pacing, EGL teardown and target SDK changes with the Android frontend.
review_queue.gdrom-state-format: Review the GD-ROM timer and CDDA series together with V62 serialization.
review_queue.capcom-networking: Review the complete modem/Capcom/libjuice series, dependency pin and build guards together.
review_queue.platform-build: Review platform build and macOS document-open changes against Hollycast targets and menus.
review_queue.lua-disc-control: Review new disc commands against Hollycast pause, resume and save protection behavior.
review_queue.logging-default: Review whether to change the default log verbosity.
review_queue.arcade-input-label: Review the WCCF button-label change separately.
review_queue.documentation: Keep Hollycast documentation; selectively adapt useful upstream instructions.
review_queue.translations: Review translations and generated libretro options separately from the backend batch.
review_queue.merge-history: History-only merge commits are not imported because their complete contents were not approved.
